title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit hardening
author: Priya Nair
description:
Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning checks at policy-evaluation time and harden audit logging for KMS operations. Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require strong guarantees that keys and encrypted artifacts remain region-bound and that any policy bypass or KMS routing decision is auditable. This PR implements enforcement hooks in the RBACv2 policy evaluator, augments audit events with KMS residency metadata, and adds a defensive fail-open/closed knob for private deployments.

What I changed: 1) rbac/v2/policy: added region_pinning constraint and enforcement during policy evaluation; any request that attempts to use a KMS key outside the request's allowed region is now rejected unless an explicit exception is present. 2) rbac/v2/audit: extended audit event schema to include kms_key_id, kms_region, key_residency_policy, policy_match_reason and policy_revision. 3) kms/integration: added extra validation for KMS client initialization to assert region affinity and fail fast if client region mismatches policy when enforce_kms_region is enabled. 4) migrations: small migration that backfills policy_revision metadata for existing RBAC v2 policies. 5) observability: new metrics rbac.kms_region_pin.violation_count and audit.kms_event.enriched_count and dashboards. 6) config: introduced feature flag SECURITY_ENFORCE_KMS_REGION (default: off for hosted, on for Dedicated/Private) and ROLLOUT_GUIDE in docs.

Files changed highlights: implementational changes are limited to the RBAC evaluator, KMS initialization layer, audit logger, and tests. No user API surface changes.

Testing: Unit tests cover policy parsing, enforcement paths (allowed/denied), and audit enrichment. Integration tests simulate cross-region key usage and assert enforced denial or logged exception depending on the feature flag. CI includes an additional security integration test job that runs against a mock KMS with region metadata.

Rollout plan: 1) Behind feature flag by default. 2) Enable in staging for Dedicated/Private demo tenants for two weeks. 3) Gradual enable for new Dedicated customers; contact account owners before enablement for existing committed capacity. 4) Provide a migration task to annotate policies with policy_revision; the migration is safe and idempotent. 5) If incidents are observed, ops can flip SECURITY_ENFORCE_KMS_REGION off to revert to audit-only mode.

Related work: ENG-6421, SEC-210, SUP-4391. Notes: this PR intentionally separates enforcement (deny on mismatch) from audit enrichment so we can roll out audit-first if necessary.
commits: Add region pinning constraint to RBAC v2 evaluator
Enrich audit events with KMS metadata and policy_revision
Validate KMS client region affinity during initialization
Add unit and integration tests for cross-region KMS enforcement
Add feature flag and rollout docs
